abstract: One of the most common causes of dementia in older adults is Alzheimer's disease (AD). Numerous mechanisms, including acetylcholine breakdown, amyloid beta buildup, neurofibrillary tangle accumulation, and inflammation, are involved in the pathogenesis of AD.
